parent.content:
Turtles are under water, and
some turtle is punctured right through by a line.
The line had gone through through the turtle colony.
This turtle moved on the line, as if hosting an intestine,
    as if moving left when the line moved left.
It could see an independent turtle on another intestine
    and spiralled regularly around it.

We are we, and
we think of water as moving on a 3D conveyor belt, and
we think of turtles underwater as entangled with us priorly, and
we think of Hermes as an entangled line and a turtle, and
we think of fibrous light as an opening.

I am yours, and
the body part of the turtle urges itself around the line.
This roulette of turtles spirals around us syntotically now.
Intraction swings under water into info.
We tell turtles what to do.
We spill our guts.
parent.readme: The aim of the Logo programming language was to help children imagine 'what they would do if they were the turtle'. (If only Logo were more informal; if only the turtles could meet.)
